# MetalKit

**Area:** [GPU](../COVERAGE.md#gpu) · **Apple:** [MetalKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metalkit) · **Issues:** [`area:gpu`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agpu)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** isim's Swift implementation (`isim/swift/overlays/MetalKit`), over isim's Metal, which renders on the CPU
  (see [Metal](Metal.md), [#329](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues/329)). `import MetalKit` re-exports Metal and
  QuartzCore, as on iOS.
- **`MTKView`:**
  - It is a `UIView` whose layer is a `CAMetalLayer` (see [QuartzCore](QuartzCore.md)).
  - A `CADisplayLink` calls `draw()` at `preferredFramesPerSecond`, or after `setNeedsDisplay()` when
    `enableSetNeedsDisplay` is set. `draw()` calls the delegate's `draw(in:)`, or a subclass's `draw(_:)`. isim's view
    rendering does not call that `draw(_:)` itself (UIView `_isim_skipsDrawRect`).
  - `currentRenderPassDescriptor` clears the current drawable and the view's depth / stencil and multisample textures,
    which are made at the drawable's size.
- **`MTKTextureLoader`:** decodes images with UIKit (`UIImage`: PNG, JPEG and the formats isim reads, and asset catalog
  images by name) into RGBA8 textures:
  - `_srgb` unless `SRGB` is false;
  - straight alpha;
  - optionally flipped by `origin`;
  - mipmaps generated by a blit.
- **Objective-C:** headers in `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/MetalKit` over the Swift classes. `MetalKit.framework` re-exports
  the overlay, and `isim/frameworks/MetalKit/MetalKit.m` holds the `MTKTextureLoader` option constants.
- **Versus Apple's Simulator:** the frames are drawn by the CPU, so a large view at full resolution draws fewer frames
  per second. Multisampling holds one sample per pixel (not antialiased). KTX / PVR files, `MDLTexture`, `MTKMesh` and
  the Model I/O bridges are not provided.

Tested (HelloMetalKit, test_metalkit) |

| `MTKTextureLoader` (`newTexture(URL:options:)`, `newTexture(data:options:)`, `newTexture(cgImage:options:)`, `newTexture(name:scaleFactor:bundle:options:)`, the completion-handler and `async` forms, `newTextures(URLs:options:)`), `MTKTextureLoader.Option` (`SRGB`, `generateMipmaps`, `allocateMipmaps`, `textureUsage`, `textureStorageMode`, `origin`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: images decoded by UIKit into RGBA8 textures; KTX, PVR and `MDLTexture` are not supported (an error); `cubeLayout` and `loadAsArray` are ignored.
